Hopefully that'll be enough proof, and Sputtervalve will assign me to one of the Tinkers' Union workshops in Gadgetzan or maybe even Undermine.

40e38019830a2256ee8238440532cc3e1b6d2e7b.Text: Heroes, ye must fight yer way to a clear extraction point within Icecrown. We'll try an' rendezvous on the ramparts!

40e3e533276b2279c030c4cd59c6a4407aa7f561.RewardText: Great, more ammo! Old Loslor's shipment finally came through! The ammo might be late, but just like my grand daddy used to tell me: late's better than never!$b$bThank you much, $N. I already have buyers eager for this stuff!

40e830c3d1d2501c0be8875d4e8b6f95b3474942.LogDescription: Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Magi and 2 Scarlet Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
40e830c3d1d2501c0be8875d4e8b6f95b3474942.QuestDescription: I was sent as a scout to do some damage and gauge the strength of Hearthglen's defenses. Some people in the Alliance feel the little town has more than historical importance. It's not my job to question what that importance is, but regardless, I'm in no shape to continue until I rest up.$B$BIf you're willing, I'd pay handsomely for some help. Start south of here at their camp near the small bulwark they've set up. If you prove strong enough, maybe I could get your help with my main goal.

40e8d7488e1ff4ad3c40f2c6016ea0c1b49f0695.CompletionText: Ah, young $C. I see you're eager to continue your studies. Good.$b$bI wonder, have you spent much time in the Emerald Dream already? Perhaps you're not prepared for that yet... In time, I'm sure.$b$bBut until then, we should discuss other matters.

40ea8870883630e1fd738eb0bd6681af2b7dc2a0.Text: He sought an artifact... a horn, I think. He left the village on a long journey in search of it.

40eb961acf98b4e74a4efdddeef09ff25b5c44af.LogDescription: Deliver the Night Elf Plans to Magister Sylastor at An'telas in the Ghostlands.
40eb961acf98b4e74a4efdddeef09ff25b5c44af.QuestDescription: You must deliver the recovered night elf plans to An'telas for me. It is to the east, on the southern slopes of Sungraze Peak, just to the northeast of the Sanctum of the Sun.$B$BMagister Sylastor is there conducting ongoing studies into the ley-line nexus energy for potential use in our fight against the Scourge. Have him look at these plans to shed some light on what it is that these night elves are up to.

40f0f5c8a6a6e98a292392ff7620934ac204f163.RewardText: Thanks for helping me out with my little plan, $N. I've been itching for months to get back at that snooty, stuck-up boy, and I'd say we did a pretty good job! Here, have this, you've earned it.

40f21bf8665cb3f87e41208034b9d2bf9a89978a.Text: Ah yes, and promptly delivered.  As always, it's a pleasure doing business with you, Corbett.

40f918b7f14beea1dc0fc869fc229eda048816b9.LogDescription: Make 5 slices of Pumpkin Pie and bring them to Francis Eaton at the feasting area right outside Orgrimmar.
40f918b7f14beea1dc0fc869fc229eda048816b9.QuestDescription: That spice bread stuffing you made is a hit, but no Pilgrim's Bounty feast is complete without a slice of pumpkin pie. It's another traditional local dish, since it uses ripe Tirisfal pumpkins that only grow around here.$B$BIf you don't know how to make pumpkin pie already, there's a recipe in your bountiful cookbook.$B$BWould you mind cooking up a few slices and bringing them to Francis Eaton outside Orgrimmar? He's bound to be running low by now.
